compared.meaning: the launcher keeps the Owner, recorder and port lease after LIFT and waits for an operator decision
compared.compatibility: NOT_CHOSEN: run_session() closes the recorder in its finally block and the launcher ends after run_session returns; the baseline session has no resident wait/continuation API outside the full-chain Owner. It would need a new continuation/STOP/lease interface (handoff item 4, second option)
compared.existing_parallel: the full-chain FullEpisodeHandoff resident Owner (not used by this scope)

compared.meaning: write an explicit holding terminal after held_after_lift, close the recorder, end the process
compared.compatibility: CHOSEN: the baseline session already ends on *_HOLDING_NEEDS_A_PERSON results this way (e.g. STOPPED_IN_LIFT_HOLDING_NEEDS_A_PERSON); the change is one boundary after held_after_lift plus LIMITED_SCOPE_TERMINAL.json after the recorder release
compared.console: Controller.status() maps a held terminal to LIMITED_HOLDING; can_prepare stays false until the existing MANUAL_RECOVERY_CONFIRMATION

preserved_fields.last_actual_joint_positions: last_actual.ticks (the LIFT stage executor's own end read, move.json end)
preserved_fields.last_goal_and_ack_readback: last_actual.goal_register + last_goal_ack.move_files -> run*/move.json last_acknowledged_goal / last_goal_write_attempt / read_after_loss
preserved_fields.torque_status_moving_last_check: last_actual.torque/status/moving; time = last_stage.recorded_at_host_s (the stage record time; the executor end read is the last bus read before release)
preserved_fields.object_hold_evidence: hold_evidence (existing held_after_lift observation: gate/ok/why/label; not a force or slip measurement)
preserved_fields.owner_and_port_release: owner.recorder.released / readers_closed from sweepick_episode.release(); executor buses close per stage
preserved_fields.normal_home: normal_home=false after LIFT (true only when an existing pre-lift way back ended RETURNED_RELEASED with torque read 0)

status_words_kept_apart.RETURNED_RELEASED: existing return + release confirmed by readback
status_words_kept_apart.safe_shutdown: NOT_PERFORMED in this scope after LIFT
status_words_kept_apart.torque_off_confirmed: false; never inferred from process exit
status_words_kept_apart.GRIP_UNAVAILABLE_HOLDING: not a contact; LIFT is not allowed (LEFT_CLOSE_UNAVAILABLE)
status_words_kept_apart.STOPPED_STATE_RECORDED: a recorded stop, not a confirmed physical stop; no further stage

last_actual.source: lift stage executor end read (move.json end)

last_goal_ack.note: per-write ACK/readback is in the stage's run*/move.json (last_acknowledged_goal, last_goal_write_attempt, read_after_loss)

hold_evidence.why: wrist image: the block at the same place and size between the jaw tips before and after the lift; jaws loaded through the lift and the hold (port owner's rows); top depth: the place where the block stood is validly observed and clear
hold_evidence.label: HELD_CONFIRMED
hold_evidence.basis: the existing held_after_lift observation; not a force/slip measurement

owner.process: this launcher process (single owner); it ends after this file
owner.port_lease: released with the recorder; executor buses are closed per stage

fake_sample_terminal_record.meaning: process exit is not a motor stop or torque-off; HOLDING != RETURNED_RELEASED != safe_shutdown != torque_off_confirmed
